question: What specific instruction is being closed off here as having been told to the addressed goddess?
premises: An anaphoric pronoun refers to a previously announced instruction.
A passive perfect marks that instruction as completed.
The resolution of the brahma-knot is named as its content.
inference: The resolution of the brahma-knot has been told to the goddess.
uncertainties: No details of that resolution are recapitulated in this verse.
plain_english: O goddess, this resolution of the brahma-knot has been told to you.
